Overview

Riobamba is a city in H with a population of 180,000. The gateway to Chimborazo volcano, a highland city with stunning Andean views and indigenous markets. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
